svg.aria-label: BridgeX logo exploration 2: angular B/X bridge glyph with a horizontal deck line
svg.title: Exploration 2 — Angular B/X bridge glyph (chosen direction)
svg.desc: An angular X built from two thick diagonal bars. The gold bar passes behind the maroon bar at the crossing (weave gap), suggesting two bridge spans joining. A horizontal gold deck line runs through the centre. The deck line was dropped in the final mark for crispness at 16px.
